description: This PHP class defines methods for retrieving and counting customer transaction reports in the Opencart admin module, including SQL query generation with filters for date ranges and customer names.

classes.name: CustomerTransaction
classes.description: A report model class that fetches customer transaction data and total counts, integrated into the Opencart admin report extension.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer transactions with optional filters (date range, customer name) and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTransactions
methods.description: Counts total number of customer transactions matching optional filters.
